## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1 (partial): CI workflow log shows file-cluster partition and parallel reviewer dispatches — the doc describes what operators see

## TDD Requirement
No RED test required — this is a GREEN documentation-only task (no behavioral content added).

Unit exemption criteria met:
1. No conditional logic — purely structural document addition
2. Any test would be a change-detector test (grep for doc text)
3. Infrastructure-boundary-only — documentation, no business logic

## Doc Router Determination
Gate 2 fires: `plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md` covers the CI llm-review pipeline. Strategy E region-split is a new strategy within the existing CI llm-review system. Target: `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md`.

## Implementation Notes

**File to modify**: `plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md`

Add a new section "Strategy E: Region-Split FALLBACK" after the existing strategy descriptions. The section must document:

1. **Trigger condition**: delta > 400 LOC or > 15 changed files (constants `REGION_SPLIT_LOC_THRESHOLD` / `REGION_SPLIT_FILE_THRESHOLD` in `region_split.py`)
2. **File clustering algorithm**: top-2 directory components; max 5 clusters; overflow cluster for excess
3. **Parallel dispatch**: all clusters dispatched simultaneously via `async_dispatch_specialists`; each cluster uses the same tier-appropriate reviewers as the standard path
4. **Dedup protocol**: `deduplicate_region_findings()` keys on (file, dimension, claim-fingerprint) with line-range overlap; MAX severity wins; dual-rationale preserved in `merged_rationale` field when severities differ
5. **Opus arch synthesis**: `dispatch_arch_synthesis` receives merged cluster findings + full original diff; surfaces boundary-only issues spanning region clusters
6. **CI log output**: operators see `INFO: diff exceeds region-split threshold` line plus per-cluster partition counts from `run_region_split` stderr
7. **Coordination note**: link to story 4911-c7ba for reviewer rubric expansion — reviewer agent interface must be stable before parallel dispatch

DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION: Gate 2 fired — target is `plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md`

## File Impact Table
| Source file | Action | Associated tests | Test classification |
|-------------|--------|-----------------|---------------------|
| `plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md` | modify | *(none)* | still-valid |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] CI-INTEGRATION.md contains Strategy E section
  Verify: grep -q "Strategy E\|region-split\|Region-Split" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md
- [ ] Section documents the 400 LOC threshold
  Verify: grep -q "400" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md
- [ ] Section documents deduplicate_region_findings and merged_rationale
  Verify: grep -q "merged_rationale\|deduplicate_region_findings" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md
- [ ] DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION emitted in completion report

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
